meta.title: Condensed view
meta.description: Appends an independent “Condensed View” block below each assistant reply, compressing prose into a shorter, conclusion-first version while keeping numbers, code, links, commands, and proper nouns intact. The condensed view leaves the original reply intact and stays out of the main conversation context, sending only the current reply for generation. Manual by default—click the block header to generate, or switch to “This session” or “All” auto mode—and you can pick any model configured in DSH inside the block (none bundled), with each generation making one model call that may incur charges.
